name: derived-ccsds-space-packet1
source: synthetic: values chosen by the vector deriver (APID 1, group flags 3, sequence count 1234, packet length 13, battery voltage 28.5, battery current -1.25, charge mode 1, SomeParameter 85, solar array voltage raw 1500 and 2345); bytes derived by hand and with a standalone stdlib program, no engine or generator run
reference: BogusSAT-2.xml CCSDSPacket entries (Packet_ID 3+1+1+11, Packet_Sequence 2+14, Packet_Length 16), CCSDSTelemetryPacket and CCSDS_SpacePacket1 criteria (Version 0, Type TM=0, SecHdrFlag NotPresent=0, APID 1), CCSDS_SpacePacket1 entries (Battery_Voltage/Current IEEE754 32 msb, Charge_Mode 1, SomeParameter 7, Solar_Array_Voltage_1/2 12 unsigned with polynomial -100.0+0.1x); engine-spec 0.5 msb order, uint, f32 (0x41e40000, 0xbfa00000), uscale ruling 1 (1500*0.1-100=50, 2345*0.1-100=134.5, both exact in doubles), 0.8 sequential (144 bits, 18 bytes), 0.30/0.33 when-at-as windows over the pads written from the as keys
